columns.description: Parent is a corporation that owns more than 50% of another corporation's capital stock. The parent company can also be a subsidiary of another corporation. If the parent also has branches, then it is a headquarters as well as being a parent company. A headquarters is a business establishment that has branches or divisions reporting to it, and is financially responsible for those branches or divisions.
